title: Committed mail wakes delivery and watch

effect.user: Accepted mail reaches an eligible receiver without waiting for the periodic tick.
assertions: Each of30accepted sends has one committed delivered mailbox row and a contiguous keyed watch event.
Duplicate wake requests do not postpone the first scheduled wake.
Idle tick callback counts remain unchanged.
exclusions: Apiary mirror and rendering (separate Home T20 fixture)

idle.why: Delivery after explicit idle, plus five quiet windows.

repeated.why: Delivery after explicit idle, plus five quiet windows.

fixture.seed: One generated stub bee per disposable owner,30unique sends at deterministic phase offsets;metal2 and metal3 run independently as owners. Fake HOME and null keychain.

recipe.readiness: Owned disposable hived relay started with owner <bind-ip> <port> <owner.json> <allowed-ip> after; stub explicitly idle and watch subscribed.
recipe.completion: 30 keyed delivery events and mailbox rows verified; five2-second owner idle windows returned.
recipe.warmup: Built native artifacts and stub explicit idle.
recipe.teardown: Collector lab.finish shuts down only owned daemon, runtime and relay; retain all receipts.
requires: Fake HOME with env -i and HIVE_NO_KEYCHAIN=1

metrics.scope: Remote collector send request to delivered watch over allowlisted lab relay; includes TCP buffering.
metrics.invariant: One durable delivered row per accepted id; no FIFO or urgency policy change.
metrics.noise: Shared host and collector overhead included; no production latency claim.

metrics.scope: Owner daemon plus idle collector task CPU per2seconds; noisy shared-host observation.
metrics.invariant: One durable delivered row per accepted id; no FIFO or urgency policy change.
metrics.noise: Shared host and collector overhead included; no production latency claim.

metrics.scope: Owner voluntary switches per2seconds; wakeup proxy only.
metrics.invariant: One durable delivered row per accepted id; no FIFO or urgency policy change.
metrics.noise: Shared host and collector overhead included; no production latency claim.

metrics.scope: Owner same-clock mailbox enqueuedAt to deliveredAt; no cross-machine clock subtraction.
metrics.collector: Committed mailbox rows verified after keyed delivered event.
metrics.invariant: All30accepted messages committed as delivered once.
metrics.noise: Date.now resolution and loaded shared host; recipe evidence only.

gaps: Field active-runtime tick cost is unmeasured; spaced sends cause approximately one full tick each.
Exact OS wakeups unmeasured (perf/bpftrace absent); idle tick callbacks and context switches retained.
Native watch relay has a roughly40ms mode, provisionally TCP buffering; no setNoDelay, no production tail claim.
Production Apiary push belongs to Home T20; independent native loopback fixture numbers must not be merged.
readiness: Loaded-host recipe proof only: no idle-host baseline or latency budget.30samples per arm on two native owners; idle ticks unchanged, CPU inconclusive, active burst cost disclosed.
